# V8 0001 — cumulative RV32 build fixes

**Target:** `src/v8/` (V8 main tree, pin `637ded7…`).
**Generated by:** the in-tree diff snapshot of all M1 RV32 fixes during
the `chromium-rv32` work; treat it as the "make `gn gen` + `ninja d8` for
`target_cpu=riscv32` work" patch.

## What it does

| File | Why |
|---|---|
| `src/codegen/riscv/macro-assembler-riscv.cc` | RV32 macro-assembler tweaks for fragile 64-bit-only paths. |
| `src/common/segmented-table.h` | RV32 (32-bit address space) sizing for V8's segmented table cage; the upstream computation only ran for 64-bit pointers. |
| `src/heap/memory-pool.h` | Disables the 64-bit-only pool size assumptions when `V8_HOST_ARCH_32_BIT`. |

The goal is purely **build cleanliness on RV32**. No runtime semantics
change for 64-bit hosts.

## Known follow-ups (deferred to a later milestone)

These are recorded in [`../../docs/known-limitations.md`](../../docs/known-limitations.md):

* `Generate_InterpreterEntryTrampoline` bytecode-budget interrupt path
  needs a register-save dance before the `CallRuntime`. The current
  workaround disables tier-up; an upstream-friendly fix has not been
  written yet.
* Post-`CallRuntime` register-preservation bug discovered during the M6
  Svelte demo run.
* `kAtomicsLoad` / Turboshaft Int64 lowering verifier mismatch on RV32.
